Markus / Ben / Laura,

Reviewed the redlines and their comments. High-level legal positions and suggested language below. I attached a short PDF with suggested wording (MSA_Redline_Suggested_Wording.pdf).

1) VAT / Withholding
- Position: Redwood will invoice gross and provide VAT registration numbers and invoices in support of customer reclaim where applicable. We will accept reverse charge only where statutory law requires reverse charge and both parties' local counsel confirm applicability.
- Suggested clause (short): "Supplier shall invoice Customer inclusive of VAT where required by law. Where reverse charge applies under applicable law, Supplier will provide an invoice indicating reverse charge and Customer will be responsible for any local VAT reporting obligations. Supplier will provide VAT registration certificates upon request and cooperate reasonably with Customer's tax advisors."

2) Net terms
- Position: We are prepared to accept Net45 as a concession for the first 6 months of the agreement for this customer, subject to a signed order form and an initial activation fee being paid within Net30 of invoice. After 6 months, standard Net30 applies. This gives Finance a runway to evaluate collection performance.

3) Minimum commitment ladder
- Position: Acceptable if we add explicit proration language and an activation fee. We should also add a catch-up clause: if cumulative usage falls below agreed minimum by the end of Q3, an adjustment invoice will be issued for the shortfall.

4) Indemnity/tax indemnity
- Position: Do not accept broad tax indemnities that extend beyond our local obligations. If BlueForge requests a tax indemnity for Customer withholding, redline to a limited clause requiring Customer to notify Redwood and provide applicable tax authority evidence.

Action items:
- Laura: confirm whether Net45 for 6 months + activation fee impacts cash forecasting and whether we require a different billing cadence.
- Ben: confirm whether you want to offer any commercial sweeteners besides activation fee (e.g., discounted usage tokens).
- Markus: once we align, I'll incorporate the suggested clauses into an updated order form and re-generate a PDF for external review.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Sr. Counsel, Commercial Contracts
Redwood Inference

Elena — thanks for the redline and the clear asks. We reviewed internally and want to propose a narrow compromise to expedite execution. Summary of proposed changes below and the updated PDF attached. If that looks good we can send a DocuSign link and close next week.

Proposed compromises:
1) Minimum commitment: Redwood will accept BlueForge's 3-tranche ramp (Q1 30%, Q2 30%, Q3 40%) as an alternative to paying the full annual minimum upfront. Redwood will apply a one-time activation fee of $20,000 due with the Q1 invoice; the activation fee will count toward the year 1 commitment. If cumulative usage by the end of Q3 is below the agreed minimum, Redwood will issue a catch-up invoice for the shortfall pro-rated to the remaining months.

2) Net terms: Redwood agrees to Net45 for the first 6 months. The activation fee is due Net30 from invoice date. After 6 months, invoices revert to Net30. This is a temporary concession to align with BlueForge's AP cycle.

3) VAT / Tax: Redwood will invoice gross where required by law and will provide VAT registration numbers and supporting invoices. Where local law requires reverse charge, Redwood will indicate reverse charge on the invoice; BlueForge will remain responsible for any local reporting. Redwood cannot accept broad tax indemnities for third-party withholding; instead we require notice and supporting evidence for any tax withholding claims.

4) Invoicing / PO: Please confirm that invoices should be sent to: BlueForge Systems, Inc., PO FIN-9876, ap@blueforge.com. We will mirror the invoicing entity on the order form.

Next steps:
- Attached: Redwood_Updated_OrderForm_BF-983.pdf (tracked changes).
- If you accept, please reply confirming acceptance of the compromises and we will send a DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/link/embedded-sign/BF-983
- I can also schedule a 30-minute call Thursday morning to walk legal/finance through the few open items if helpful.

Thanks — looking forward to closing.

Best,
